mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alert_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_record SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_review_record (alert_id, from_status, to_status, reason, operator_id, operator_username, operator_name, operated_at) VALUES (#{alertId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorUsername}, #{operatorName}, #{operatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alert_review_record WHERE alert_id = #{alertId} ORDER BY operated_at DESC, id DESC
